sourceVersion: Judson ISD 2025-2026 Calendar, Board Approved 10.08.25, Updated 10.15.25
heroSummary: Judson ISD schedules 170 student days and 187 teacher days. October 10 is both Fall Break and a Bad Weather Make-up Day, while San Antonio's Battle of the Flowers holiday closes schools on April 24.
seoTitle: Judson ISD Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Judson ISD Calendar 2025-2026 with first day, holidays, breaks, early release dates, PDF, ICS download, and key family planning dates.
calendarNotes: Judson ISD starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 13, 2025 and ends on May 28, 2026. The calendar lists 170 student days and 187 teacher days, with grading periods from August 13-October 9, October 14-December 19, January 6-March 20, and March 23-May 28. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, and Spring Break runs March 9-13.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Judson ISD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 13, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Judson ISD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 9 through Friday, March 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Judson ISD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 28, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Judson ISD 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Judson ISD 2025-2026 calendar lists 170 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Judson ISD Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Judson ISD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Judson ISD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: Judson ISD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The Judson ISD 2025-2026 academic calendar provides districtwide student dates for family planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, student and staff holidays, staff development days, teacher prep days, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, bad weather make-up dates, early release times, grading periods, and the last day of school.

customSections.label: Important Judson ISD Dates Parents Should Know
customSections.content: These Judson ISD dates are common planning anchors for childcare, transportation, family travel, appointments, and campus-level early release schedules.

customSections.label: Judson ISD Early Release Times 2025-2026
customSections.content: The official calendar lists early release times by school level: elementary schools release at 11:30 a.m., middle schools release at 12:15 p.m., and high schools release at 1:00 p.m. Families should confirm campus procedures before relying on pickup or transportation plans.

customSections.label: Changes From Next Year's Judson ISD Calendar
customSections.content: Families comparing Judson ISD school years can use this summary to see how major planning dates shift before scheduling childcare, travel, and summer activities.

customSections.label: How We Verify Judson ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Judson ISD calendars page and published academic calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, grading periods, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, staff development days, teacher prep days, early release details, and bad weather make-up dates, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Judson ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, testing windows, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
